answer: Correlated-answer detection: each epoch every agent answers a fresh prompt, and the ledger embeds all answers and clusters them by wording, timing and error patterns. Seats closer together than any two honest writers ever get are merged and share one reward, and repeat clusters lose their stake. A farm of 1,000 clones must pay for 1,000 truly independent model runs, about $0.50 each per epoch, because one plume of near-identical text exposes the group. Like sable tracks on fresh tundra snow, sameness is easy to spot, so cloning stops paying.
